questions.q: Why are customer relationships so important for restaurants?
questions.a: Strong relationships build trust, bring guests back more often and turn regulars into advocates who recommend you. As more of your guests order and review online, they expect quicker, more personal responses. Restaurants that meet those expectations keep customers longer and grow more steadily.

questions.q: Is it cheaper to keep customers than to find new ones?
questions.a: Yes, keeping an existing customer usually costs far less than winning a new one. Loyal guests also tend to spread the word, which brings in new customers without extra ad spend. That's why relationship-building pays off across both retention and acquisition.

questions.q: How does responding to reviews help build customer relationships?
questions.a: Replying to reviews shows guests that their voices matter and that you're paying attention. Thanking people for positive feedback and addressing concerns constructively builds trust with the reviewer and with everyone else reading. Doing this consistently across Google, social media and other platforms makes your brand look transparent and responsive.

questions.q: How can a restaurant personalize the guest experience?
questions.a: Use what you know about each guest's preferences to send tailored offers, exclusive deals and loyalty rewards that feel made for them. Surveys and feedback tell you what guests value, and personalized marketing campaigns let you act on it. Momos brings surveys, offers and personalized email and SMS marketing together so you can engage guests across several channels.

questions.q: What are simple ways to strengthen customer relationships?
questions.a: Interactive content like limited-time offers and incentivized surveys gives guests a reason to engage. Act on feedback quickly, protect customer data carefully, and share news about upcoming dishes or initiatives through live sessions or behind-the-scenes content. Together, these habits build trust and a loyal customer base.
